answer_1.quote: We introduce two controllable text-to-text generation tasks on the dataset: (1) generating and (2) reframing unhelpful thoughts, given a persona and pattern as the context.
answer_1.outputs: generated unhelpful thoughts and reframed thoughts

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore, which capture the semantic similarity between the generated thought and the human reference. We also report distinct-1, and distinct-2 metrics to measure the diversity of the generations.

answer_4.quote: We collect human ratings of 100 random thoughts from the test set. We evaluate the generated rewrites along three dimensions through Yes/No binary ratings: (i) fluency, (ii) meaning preservation, and (iii) quality, which here evaluates if the generated thought exhibits the given unhelpful thought pattern.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated output on three binary Yes/No questions: fluency, meaning preservation, and quality (presence of the target pattern).
